title: Castlevania: Circle of the Moon - Underground Gallery (Death Mantis Corridor)
description:
The background seen in the corridors of the Underground Gallery where Death Mantis appear, from Castlevania: Circle of the Moon. It uses 34 tiles, meaning it can be used with foreground with a lot of decorations to compensate the empty space it has.

Credit would be great, but is optional.
